▌翾风回雪 · 奥黛塔

寂冬覆雪，振翎成旋

==========

「她跳啊，跳啊…人们的目光与心都随她的舞姿翻飞，又随着幕布的合闭而垂落♪~

「但奥黛塔啊，奥黛塔，至冬堡的奥黛塔，科洛列夫茨基剧团的奥黛塔，不属于自己的奥黛塔♪~

「你究竟是喜欢在舞台上万众瞩目，还是喜欢在雪原上独自起舞呢♪~」

——一段从沃雅妮莎房间里传来的歌声

在至冬，要让冰封大地上的人们心甘情愿走进剧院，并非一件容易的事。寒风刺骨的日子里，人们更愿意缩在壁炉旁，而非踏雪去看一场演出。

但奥黛塔的芭蕾演出是个例外。

每当她的名字出现在剧院海报上，售票窗口前便会排起长队。不是因为她笑容甜美，事实上她几乎从不对观众笑；也不是因为她为人亲切，演出落幕，她不会在舞台多逗留一刻。人们来看她纯粹是因为，在她踮起足尖的刹那，连至冬呼啸的寒风都仿佛为之静止，而她精准的舞步，则令全场屏息。对追随她的观众而言，这份冰冷反而为其魅力锦上添花。

这位沐浴在聚光灯下的少女，同时亦是愚人众的一员。

剧团的排练在清晨，愚人众的训练在深夜，个人练习与突发任务则穿插其间。练功房里压腿压到极限后翩然起舞，训练场上击倒对手后转身赶往下一程，日复一日，她宛如音乐盒上的舞者，永不停歇地旋转，仿佛不知疲惫，也无须休息。

朋友曾经好奇地问她：「在芭蕾演出和愚人众之间奔波，不累吗？」

她偏了偏头，认真思索片刻，然后平淡地回答：「习惯了。」

","switch":true,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

在别的国家提起「舞者」这个词，人们总会联想到某个亲切温暖的形象，仿佛是漫漫人生旅途中一抹治愈的光。

而在至冬，一提到舞者，大多数人脑海中首先浮现的，却是那道冷冽的身影。

作为科洛列夫茨基剧团的首席芭蕾舞者，当奥黛塔・苏佩茜娃出现在宣传海报上时，她的表情始终如一：平淡的眼神、微抿的双唇，宛如一尊凝着薄霜的雕像。

与之形成鲜明对比的，是她追随者们炽热的崇拜。原因很简单：无可挑剔的身形、冷冽而极具张力的表演，每一个舞步、每一次抬手都如宝石切割面般精准，折射出摄人心魄的火彩。

谁都无法漠视此等姿态背后所付出的努力。当奥黛塔站上舞台的那一刻，任何质疑声都会霎时间消失。

而谢幕后她极少加演，即便有粉丝献花赞美，她的回应也总是简短至极：

「嗯。谢谢支持。再见。」

这并非她刻意摆出高姿态，只因灯光闪耀的舞台背后，还有别的职责等待着她。她的生活恰如墙上被填满的日历，没有留给自己的一丝空白。

若在深夜瞥见一道无声掠过的身影，轻盈得不像是寻常之人，最好不要因为好奇而轻举妄动。毕竟至冬的雪夜如此寒冷，体面的好市民们都在家中安睡，会在此时出行的恐怕另有使命在身。

但第二天清晨，奥黛塔又会准时出现在剧院的舞蹈房里。有时里面传出隐约乐声，有时只有足尖点地时细微的闷响。镜墙映出她反复抬腿、落下的身影，精准如节拍器。

当晨光渐亮，其他团员推门进来，常会露出惊讶的神色——

这位首席芭蕾舞者不会没回过家吧？

878396753878493773.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"08_1205_刮大风了…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"在沙漠的时候…","content":"…还好不会在这种地方开见面会。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/45473788301a4b871cf2a8123ef1dbf4_1538995630760911247.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"09_1206_在沙漠的时候…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"早上好…","content":"我已经热身完毕，随时可以行动。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a21e4c3cce2b873dd6652506e666f16b_2599392553288885712.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"10_1001_早上好…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"中午好…","content":"我不需要午睡，午后这种不适合训练的时间，我通常会看看舞剧剧本。嗯？你问这些信纸吗？是沃雅妮莎塞给我的粉丝来信，她要我好好看完。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/398937c87334c2d3f96913b346512b66_3034357590175906970.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"11_1002_中午好…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚饭时间到了吗？等下就要登台，吃一个煮鸡蛋就够了，等今晚演出全部结束之后，再随便吃点吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/4340bf0e8c1bc67f5260874554ca71a6_5720287886337847375.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"12_1003_晚上好…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"晚安…","content":"…任务完成，训练量达标，新舞蹈也练习完毕。表情管理有些不足，还需要再对着镜子调整一下…已经到这个时间了吗？你先休息吧，我还有安排。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/926fb8e476df0a56396efcaa939856e8_4730770608107774903.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"13_1004_晚安…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社","content":"严冬计划推行后，来剧院看演出的观众越来越少了。大家的生活已经跌入困境，更有危害民众的蛀虫，对此我无法无动于衷。我知道仅凭一己之力无法扭转局势，但我仍想做一些力所能及的事情。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b3c44d371d6432491cee24406e945ca6_6194371081673084657.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"14_2001_关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于奥黛塔自己·记性","content":"以前的记忆一直烙印在脑海中，在夜深人静的时候，像映影一样反复播放…记性太好不是好事。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/ef7ae34d10ec571bc12917ed78557902_4236847732902212307.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"15_2005_关于奥黛塔自己·记性_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·寄托","content":"来自他人的保护就像刚刚凝结而成的薄冰一样，是十分脆弱的东西，我不会把希望寄托在别人身上。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/2ca5e37c95ea22994598de35e2870a65_3681159792552502431.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"16_2003_关于我们·寄托_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·伤口","content":"我对痛觉的感受很迟钝，等我察觉伤口时，伤口已经结痂了。这样也好。无论是练习舞蹈还是接受愚人众特训，都不会因为身体状况耽误我的日程。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6e461b7a89a57e512ef3b2ee0b641b7c_3749153713924215770.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"17_2002_关于我们·伤口_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于「星之楔」…","content":"以前，在一次训练中，极寒冻伤了我的腿脚，让我近乎失去知觉，最后是在「星之楔」散发出的亮光中醒来的。不过从没有听说「星之楔」能将人唤醒的传闻，当时醒来是因为…我本能地想要活下去吗…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/42843a44d964ecd4d2a117ed476a66fb_2252934886180870404.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"18_3006_关于「星之楔」…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"每一次彩排，我都会当作正式演出一样认真对待。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/7ad4f8dfa14ae38c66429fe30b152e9b_3814541138300320387.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"19_3002_有什么想要分享…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"有些冰醋栗吃起来不够甜，只要撒一些细盐，就会变得香甜好吃了。据说是有了咸味的衬托，甜味就会被放大。一位粉丝告诉我的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/0c4e3947696b152b3f3905672136fea7_5212499688541422412.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"20_3003_感兴趣的见闻…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于罗莎琳·曾经","content":"罗莎琳有恩于我，但我也一度憎恨着她。她的要求非常严苛，在她手下训练的那段时间，挨冻、累倒、受伤与生病都是常有的事情。曾经我天真地想，只要我能独立站上舞台，靠跳芭蕾舞也能养活自己和母亲了，我就离开愚人众给她看。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/66d11c484b4773ff2cac20cf3df8740f_4902915681063710454.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"21_4001_关于罗莎琳·曾经_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于罗莎琳·燃珀","content":"人不在了，很多话就失去了说出口的意义。「燃珀」砸碎起来是那么容易，却让误会和伤痛显得更加讽刺…为什么事到如今，我们才能互相理解呢？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9f624554be761f3ed3daeea8451dda6f_4147395518317474848.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22_4002_关于罗莎琳·燃珀_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于「女皇」陛下…","content":"「女皇」陛下是全至冬的信仰，她事务繁忙，鲜少露面。我能见到她的次数寥寥无几，她十分庄重威严，她的目光不管落在哪里，都像是万年不化的冰雪一般冰冷但坚定。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/5859eeb9265d45c807b979773bc4ee2a_5196290595817723952.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"23_4003_关于「女皇」陛下…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于「少女」大人…","content":"她走路的姿态好像一片羽毛在飘起飘落。任何一位舞者都会羡慕这份轻盈。沃雅妮莎也曾和我聊起过她空灵的歌声。但我们看到与羡慕的，都是她「台前」的模样，我们并不了解真实的她心中是否背负着不为人知的痛苦，不是吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/f7bb0007d8d917c2c9fcda88abd489a9_1050579702622084002.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"24_4004_关于「少女」大人…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于「仆人」大人…","content":"壁炉之家的孩子们都将「仆人」大人视为「父亲」。有父亲庇佑的孩子，成长路上总归会少些冰雪风雨。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/904b9862f2965915b487715ee3ec2abe_5389145346698388520.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"25_4005_关于「仆人」大人…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于「木偶」大人…","content":"从前罗莎琳参加完「木偶」大人的茶会，心情都会变得比平时更好——虽然要求依旧严苛，但语气明显缓和了许多，任何人都能察觉出来。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9c344bc430a4819aefe329f2914de9c2_4359005236854881102.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"26_4006_关于「木偶」大人…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于沃雅妮莎·微笑","content":"第一次「女皇」陛下要来科洛列夫茨基剧团看我们演出的时候，沃雅妮莎提前把这个消息告诉了我，我回答说嗯。结果她伸出食指把我的嘴角提了上去，硬是制造出一个微笑，还要我跟着她一起念：「太、好、了！」我依然不觉得「女皇」陛下喜欢看到那样的笑容。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/54cc8618544fa066d5e43aa6a888f9e8_9136620846964118604.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"27_4007_关于沃雅妮莎·微笑_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于沃雅妮莎·看病","content":"沃雅妮莎生病的时候总会缠着我，让我陪着她一起…理由是万一需要打针或者吃苦药的话，她会很害怕的，所以想要紧紧抓住我的胳膊。我的痛觉很不明显，自然也不会甩开她。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/61b5de19b1aa4090e1c8acd2ee3319d2_8832133073302932979.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29_4009_关于阿罗夏…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于阿罗夏…","content":"身为猎户养活自己并不难，但他还是经常来剧院打零工，为了援助那些受苦的人们…我并不奇怪他会加入呼啸社。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/81706f9959699696df3c00dfe571d843_3424566768657392754.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29_4009_关于阿罗夏…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于米提亚…","content":"这位…「粉丝」先生，他经常来剧院观看我和沃雅妮莎的表演。但每次表演开始，他都在低着头写些什么，在一众翘首看向舞台的观众中很是醒目。或许他的围巾比他更懂得欣赏演出。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/1e430f819c5d231d7a618e051f519225_9190587144196850986.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"30_4010_关于米提亚…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于瓦列里…","content":"瓦列里少校，一位有着严格时间观念的愚人众军官，听说他总用一种冷静且骇人的态度为同僚安排工作。但我们所属不同所以鲜有交集，而且…我该做的事情并不需要任何人提醒。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/5789969c629a8e64057fb8de711a2372_4581490761740572736.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"31_4011_关于瓦列里…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于薇斯纳…","content":"别因为她有对翅膀，就把她当成华丽无害的蝴蝶，那个受人簇拥的家伙是冬契军的总司令，冰雪之中的猎食者。你要擦亮眼睛，别被热情的笑容骗了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9e44c0c892a1b37304bcf65a5063b227_8023125704417842908.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"32_4012_关于薇斯纳…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其一","content":"我的日程安排比较紧凑，等会儿还有训练。请见谅。要聊天的话，我们长话短说。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/c10f235c9307f7bd4cf3c77da5356ac3_1855834313231516681.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"33_5001_想要了解奥黛塔·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其二","content":"我的母亲出自芭蕾世家，父亲曾效力愚人众，他们因一次演出而结缘，那是一段能让任何听者都露出笑容的浪漫往事。幼时，母亲会带我一起轻盈地跳舞，父亲会给我买漂亮的新舞裙。我唯一的烦恼是每天到底要从糖果罐子里选择哪一块。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/0286ca92ecf860e38f9cf48a05d59d9d_6514507970415352099.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34_5002_想要了解奥黛塔·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其三","content":"后来父亲因公殉职的噩耗传来，母亲悲痛欲绝，在演出时摔断了腿。糖果罐子里所有的糖都洒了出去，而我被关在了那里面。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/2027c3bd42a53f9e577c07550852be79_7683351146765902805.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"35_5003_想要了解奥黛塔·其三_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其四","content":"再后来的事情，你也知道了。这些回忆被我咀嚼了太多次，已经不会再伤害到我了。但对抗命运过程中获得的力量，却是属于我自己的。我不会忘记这一点。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/7dc759293e0c1d029280baa6deff2b28_2465980597139275572.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"36_5004_想要了解奥黛塔·其四_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其五","content":"我不想对任何粉丝说这些，好在你不是。我的身份已经太多了，任何一面最好都保持其应有的剔透…我会向着我心中的完美舞下去。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6e740206d0273c9b7470b763231644d5_5068352711970223916.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"37_5005_想要了解奥黛塔·其五_cn.mp3"},{"name":"奥黛塔的爱好…","content":"从始至终我都很喜欢芭蕾，我会竭尽全力在这个舞台上为观众带来我能跳出的最好的舞蹈。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/ed766528f499243937d75f7edf0be4c2_6430936983446363457.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"38_6001_奥黛塔的爱好…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"奥黛塔的烦恼…","content":"说实话我一直觉得自己不太受小动物欢迎。剧院周围经常有小猫出没，沃雅妮莎会拉着我一起去喂它，我一走过去，小猫就开始磨爪子…嗯？你说那是欢迎我的意思吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/7d2934c9f5da6f8ce414712e6a390652_9128363417555315106.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"39_6012_奥黛塔的烦恼…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"餐厅快打烊时，会半价出售当天的沙拉，从前有段时间经常吃这个。放久了的沙拉味道当然比不上新鲜的，但因为口感实在熟悉，反倒让人安心。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9c6903f2abc5423b424f657ba90ce2d7_6310742214091651831.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"40_6003_喜欢的食物…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"从我个人喜好上来说，并没有难以下咽的食物。但作为芭蕾舞者，必须在饮食上保持克制，每日饮食计划外的食物是不推荐吃的。所以我不吃。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/8e797d814d66f6923d0b2b5040d330a4_6566829203175877583.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"41_6004_讨厌的食物…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"这几天演出比较多，或许…不，没什么。谢谢你，这个很美味。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a5a90e41a2cd03bb41cad8193afad648_5128716091280580441.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"42_6007_收到赠礼·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"一道菜？更像…一整天的食物。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/bc28f2d43d385da23df57cee95bd14a8_6705518838470864298.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"43_6008_收到赠礼·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"抱歉，我在控制体重。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/70759046937bf2a103594b33b5222a26_3981637903207912273.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"44_6009_收到赠礼·其三_cn.mp3"},{"name":"生日…","content":"生日快乐。不知道你想要怎样的生日礼物？我收到的总是鲜花、舞鞋与音乐盒。但我猜那并不是你的愿望。不如你向我许愿吧，只要是我能实现的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/0df7a899d561d59947ded2179f2cdc8b_759753786129862801.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"45_7001_生日…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"还欠缺了一些什么…再加点训练量好了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/17e193a0227268e301f675614220a2df_9042352995083093415.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"46_8001_突破的感受·起_cn.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"嗯，动作更加精准了。保持这样的训练量。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/fadeefae7958c1fd0754735d80c70c05_2589544113234079203.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"47_8002_突破的感受·承_cn.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"现在我有信心能够完美地完成鞭转了。不过训练量不能减。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/c0ae906a329d4efc1b8aabbee9905840_1515741417938390741.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"48_8003_突破的感受·转_cn.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"「情感也是芭蕾舞不可欠缺的一部分。」现在我能理解它的含义了，谢谢你一直以来的陪伴和支持，今天有我的演出，这是门票。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/38cab0b9a55d4188ab08371320b5ff8e_4844120288688871082.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"49_8004_突破的感受·合_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"开始了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/95c8e1058755acc0c4e01c86bf267587_1416048761290120716.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"50_100 _name":"67_500001_倒下·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"不行，要站起来才对…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/cc24268d39b2004f31538c3a17a2b5d8_1622332628724365299.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"68_500002_倒下·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"原来，还能感到疼痛…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a74a8f92921b62a65ea5896d6f2c2c72_3405079681637313048.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"69_500003_倒下·其三_cn.mp3"},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"…嗯？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/7fad98cc091f15fd1792553b77ac271d_4724186046414748780.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"70_900001_普通受击·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"普通受击·其二","content":"然后呢？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/7328a7315b2ca62b224929444729975b_2768134808964486763.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"71_900002_普通受击·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"就这吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/822a8b0b42436f24d68545e3c289aea1_726658496924599480.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"72_910001_重受击·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"不痛不痒。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/d1a80f5a73e9f34652984f67c1940a6e_1735005369237213508.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"73_910002_重受击·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"我准备好了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/f2f4878df9d71db6fc400182f8612079_4188198658836342489.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"74_600001_加入队伍·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"是特邀演出吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b0d87596983d55ddca41a4bbfa919bc8_2897197994568459861.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"75_600002_加入队伍·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"这次去哪里？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/50498e1ed31cf46894909f5a36bb7c32_4311225547450703619.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"76_600003_加入队伍·其三_cn.mp3"}],"tab_id":"1694069109341_0"},{"tab_name":"日语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"…谢谢你的支持，签名的后面需要什么图案？一片羽毛可以吗？噢，不是粉丝。看来是我误会了。重新自我介绍一下，奥黛塔，至冬科洛列夫茨基剧团的芭蕾舞者…依旧谢谢你的支持。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/541e7a77b691b27be9896896a8b0735e_7470181432342241871.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"01_1006_初次见面…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"闲聊·忙碌","content":"如果没有别的事情的话，我先去练习舞蹈了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/e806e65c274582d5dbc51f157daec534_8079630223339878173.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"02_1101_闲聊·忙碌_jp.mp3"},{"name":"闲聊·简单","content":"能简单回应的事情，不需要长篇大论。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/fe186880bf9ed532c4886ab3b71ee4b3_4950508428416857715.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"03_1102_闲聊·简单_jp.mp3"},{"name":"闲聊·时间","content":"时间能变成双倍…不，三倍就好了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/5c210684fc01e2961561c656048313a1_267845614285506991.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"04_1103_闲聊·时间_jp.mp3"},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"雨滴落下时淅淅沥沥的声音总能让我感到平静，这样的天气很适合独自练舞。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/232e47593e09c0a22bbf37760ca39456_188385027961972656.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"05_1201_下雨的时候…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"平静而美好的时刻总是短暂的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/e7890f804bf79b81646b1875403e08ac_1486124603819571430.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"06_1202_雨过天晴…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"至冬的雪，向来冷得刺骨，又永无尽头。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/585d3e30b30ca9b4465b8f57adca67d8_3313065597659662064.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"07_1204_下雪的时候…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"发型…等一下再重新梳理吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/e3b2032efa529a61f06ac90b122c4174_3361969482360799492.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"08_1205_刮大风了…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"在沙漠的时候…","content":"…还好不会在这种地方开见面会。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/907a28066a4b2a8e8d7f061638045f8f_8995330056016813648.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"09_1206_在沙漠的时候…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"早上好…","content":"我已经热身完毕，随时可以行动。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/7a91552b1151fae2555ed50b00ff0d83_8666419159904187178.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"10_1001_早上好…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"中午好…","content":"我不需要午睡，午后这种不适合训练的时间，我通常会看看舞剧剧本。嗯？你问这些信纸吗？是沃雅妮莎塞给我的粉丝来信，她要我好好看完。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/0928efa395335ce4aa43c367fa20f867_2093125648453005751.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"11_1002_中午好…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚饭时间到了吗？等下就要登台，吃一个煮鸡蛋就够了，等今晚演出全部结束之后，再随便吃点吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/cbd250e32451b4c6860f4d81998cdfc2_1795378971943035192.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"12_1003_晚上好…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"晚安…","content":"…任务完成，训练量达标，新舞蹈也练习完毕。表情管理有些不足，还需要再对着镜子调整一下…已经到这个时间了吗？你先休息吧，我还有安排。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/56c6f4e5861cb6874971306920b32eae_4904537753355902316.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"13_1004_晚安…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社","content":"严冬计划推行后，来剧院看演出的观众越来越少了。大家的生活已经跌入困境，更有危害民众的蛀虫，对此我无法无动于衷。我知道仅凭一己之力无法扭转局势，但我仍想做一些力所能及的事情。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/56c6f4e5861cb6874971306920b32eae_4695650596091794397.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"14_2001_关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于奥黛塔自己·记性","content":"以前的记忆一直烙印在脑海中，在夜深人静的时候，像映影一样反复播放…记性太好不是好事。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/072f9de017ec4615b876306fb7b88121_6471354779618817895.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"15_2005_关于奥黛塔自己·记性_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·寄托","content":"来自他人的保护就像刚刚凝结而成的薄冰一样，是十分脆弱的东西，我不会把希望寄托在别人身上。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/650c0977e7a565f9265f31d91cc29a20_3356677054125676836.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"16_2003_关于我们·寄托_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·伤口","content":"我对痛觉的感受很迟钝，等我察觉伤口时，伤口已经结痂了。这样也好。无论是练习舞蹈还是接受愚人众特训，都不会因为身体状况耽误我的日程。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/87a39224ffb34d87f14a88e79474608a_5391006182514828677.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"17_2002_关于我们·伤口_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于「星之楔」…","content":"以前，在一次训练中，极寒冻伤了我的腿脚，让我近乎失去知觉，最后是在「星之楔」散发出的亮光中醒来的。不过从没有听说「星之楔」能将人唤醒的传闻，当时醒来是因为…我本能地想要活下去吗…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/8fe1c96416f83d2310f4b6fdfb2cd3f9_2037997277276717677.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"18_3006_关于「星之楔」…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"每一次彩排，我都会当作正式演出一样认真对待。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/8fe1c96416f83d2310f4b6fdfb2cd3f9_7792773795995461747.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"19_3002_有什么想要分享…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"有些冰醋栗吃起来不够甜，只要撒一些细盐，就会变得香甜好吃了。据说是有了咸味的衬托，甜味就会被放大。一位粉丝告诉我的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/39bffca2e26362a67cb70e254e120cdc_6778640715647946633.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"20_3003_感兴趣的见闻…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于罗莎琳·曾经","content":"罗莎琳有恩于我，但我也一度憎恨着她。她的要求非常严苛，在她手下训练的那段时间，挨冻、累倒、受伤与生病都是常有的事情。曾经我天真地想，只要我能独立站上舞台，靠跳芭蕾舞也能养活自己和母亲了，我就离开愚人众给她看。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/bef3b2b6ddf540191f3a6d719e20e735_8574827366548031464.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"21_4001_关于罗莎琳·曾经_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于罗莎琳·燃珀","content":"人不在了，很多话就失去了说出口的意义。「燃珀」砸碎起来是那么容易，却让误会和伤痛显得更加讽刺…为什么事到如今，我们才能互相理解呢？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/d387bcfa6e2c883c697f285ec165fd87_6480316306373752600.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22_4002_关于罗莎琳·燃珀_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于「女皇」陛下…","content":"「女皇」陛下是全至冬的信仰，她事务繁忙，鲜少露面。我能见到她的次数寥寥无几，她十分庄重威严，她的目光不管落在哪里，都像是万年不化的冰雪一般冰冷但坚定。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a2f3f04409f87d547c07ae5a43443fd1_8101838517672950534.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"23_4003_关于「女皇」陛下…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于「少女」大人…","content":"她走路的姿态好像一片羽毛在飘起飘落。任何一位舞者都会羡慕这份轻盈。沃雅妮莎也曾和我聊起过她空灵的歌声。但我们看到与羡慕的，都是她「台前」的模样，我们并不了解真实的她心中是否背负着不为人知的痛苦，不是吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/cec61f55790fd7de9db314a1429bb12d_5836372381114244537.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"24_4004_关于「少女」大人…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于「仆人」大人…","content":"壁炉之家的孩子们都将「仆人」大人视为「父亲」。有父亲庇佑的孩子，成长路上总归会少些冰雪风雨。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/db27fee305ac96b9b37c02f695c1d9dd_5505728152539391562.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"25_4005_关于「仆人」大人…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于「木偶」大人…","content":"从前罗莎琳参加完「木偶」大人的茶会，心情都会变得比平时更好——虽然要求依旧严苛，但语气明显缓和了许多，任何人都能察觉出来。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/fdb792c71a1b228f55d903bbedb0ce18_4854792463379334382.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"26_4006_关于「木偶」大人…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于沃雅妮莎·微笑","content":"第一次「女皇」陛下要来科洛列夫茨基剧团看我们演出的时候，沃雅妮莎提前把这个消息告诉了我，我回答说嗯。结果她伸出食指把我的嘴角提了上去，硬是制造出一个微笑，还要我跟着她一起念：「太、好、了！」我依然不觉得「女皇」陛下喜欢看到那样的笑容。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6df0b238c1a3667bbc028b4ae7f444e5_8770233766575459196.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"27_4007_关于沃雅妮莎·微笑_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于沃雅妮莎·看病","content":"沃雅妮莎生病的时候总会缠着我，让我陪着她一起…理由是万一需要打针或者吃苦药的话，她会很害怕的，所以想要紧紧抓住我的胳膊。我的痛觉很不明显，自然也不会甩开她。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/5cade11ed1770651b401ab44123d89be_6974992085963060263.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"28_4008_关于沃雅妮莎·看病_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于阿罗夏…","content":"身为猎户养活自己并不难，但他还是经常来剧院打零工，为了援助那些受苦的人们…我并不奇怪他会加入呼啸社。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/988ca6445600a1901345aad8a5f36225_4424512775690968372.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29_4009_关于阿罗夏…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于米提亚…","content":"这位…「粉丝」先生，他经常来剧院观看我和沃雅妮莎的表演。但每次表演开始，他都在低着头写些什么，在一众翘首看向舞台的观众中很是醒目。或许他的围巾比他更懂得欣赏演出。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/3ebe895e62d0ecdef947d3d1bb445be0_6027717250166217287.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"30_4010_关于米提亚…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于瓦列里…","content":"瓦列里少校，一位有着严格时间观念的愚人众军官，听说他总用一种冷静且骇人的态度为同僚安排工作。但我们所属不同所以鲜有交集，而且…我该做的事情并不需要任何人提醒。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/e487aad5da37d962bf6072e60a895dcf_3214399323387220636.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"31_4011_关于瓦列里…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于薇斯纳…","content":"别因为她有对翅膀，就把她当成华丽无害的蝴蝶，那个受人簇拥的家伙是冬契军的总司令，冰雪之中的猎食者。你要擦亮眼睛，别被热情的笑容骗了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9d75d28d74ce0549aeb649a02c643f7b_1792283826941098597.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"32_4012_关于薇斯纳…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其一","content":"我的日程安排比较紧凑，等会儿还有训练。请见谅。要聊天的话，我们长话短说。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/c07308c9ec7eee28f9baabc5f20d24c9_4425383438280749489.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"33_5001_想要了解奥黛塔·其一_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其二","content":"我的母亲出自芭蕾世家，父亲曾效力愚人众，他们因一次演出而结缘，那是一段能让任何听者都露出笑容的浪漫往事。幼时，母亲会带我一起轻盈地跳舞，父亲会给我买漂亮的新舞裙。我唯一的烦恼是每天到底要从糖果罐子里选择哪一块。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/78c643138056593d52a8139931623352_7322300190103729227.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34_5002_想要了解奥黛塔·其二_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其三","content":"后来父亲因公殉职的噩耗传来，母亲悲痛欲绝，在演出时摔断了腿。糖果罐子里所有的糖都洒了出去，而我被关在了那里面。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/78c643138056593d52a8139931623352_4331477611807952150.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"35_5003_想要了解奥黛塔·其三_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其四","content":"再后来的事情，你也知道了。这些回忆被我咀嚼了太多次，已经不会再伤害到我了。但对抗命运过程中获得的力量，却是属于我自己的。我不会忘记这一点。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/78c9376b45724d77f48441239d2010db_5957811481271412219.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"36_5004_想要了解奥黛塔·其四_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其五","content":"我不想对任何粉丝说这些，好在你不是。我的身份已经太多了，任何一面最好都保持其应有的剔透…我会向着我心中的完美舞下去。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/01d2ec092aa144493753c0775cb7adb2_4474029326124962128.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"37_5005_想要了解奥黛塔·其五_jp.mp3"},{"name":"奥黛塔的爱好…","content":"从始至终我都很喜欢芭蕾，我会竭尽全力在这个舞台上为观众带来我能跳出的最好的舞蹈。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6ca61233f5be88af872fc36ac84513ea_1521180660342237908.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"38_6001_奥黛塔的爱好…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"奥黛塔的烦恼…","content":"说实话我一直觉得自己不太受小动物欢迎。剧院周围经常有小猫出没，沃雅妮莎会拉着我一起去喂它，我一走过去，小猫就开始磨爪子…嗯？你说那是欢迎我的意思吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a3a0cb6a255c0c4d8eb4f0fb4fd35777_7069970227138344725.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"39_6012_奥黛塔的烦恼…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"餐厅快打烊时，会半价出售当天的沙拉，从前有段时间经常吃这个。放久了的沙拉味道当然比不上新鲜的，但因为口感实在熟悉，反倒让人安心。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/c7aab89492080c11f7a1e79b0a81246d_8251592619926623472.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"40_6003_喜欢的食物…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"从我个人喜好上来说，并没有难以下咽的食物。但作为芭蕾舞者，必须在饮食上保持克制，每日饮食计划外的食物是不推荐吃的。所以我不吃。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a0c177e9d393a9c4b6c12afc1a226678_4610122470763176413.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"41_6004_讨厌的食物…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"这几天演出比较多，或许…不，没什么。谢谢你，这个很美味。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/207161fc328104dbc8a099aa0aa979e8_8972944459838006455.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"42_6007_收到赠礼·其一_jp.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"一道菜？更像…一整天的食物。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/996e5674641c78194e0c950ae47e97b1_5239132739402068292.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"43_6008_收到赠礼·其二_jp.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"抱歉，我在控制体重。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/d7a2eb007fe4ce4a539e7e20ecb86ea6_6889512606119995552.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"44_6009_收到赠礼·其三_jp.mp3"},{"name":"生日…","content":"生日快乐。不知道你想要怎样的生日礼物？我收到的总是鲜花、舞鞋与音乐盒。但我猜那并不是你的愿望。不如你向我许愿吧，只要是我能实现的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b1ceba3b1858c612dfdf7f905d26b8b5_3391883490279722286.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"45_7001_生日…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"还欠缺了一些什么…再加点训练量好了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/4477263a84aa8ef544ef47ee33f47871_3860519456359759057.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"46_8001_突破的感受·起_jp.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"嗯，动作更加精准了。保持这样的训练量。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a526d25a752a841447fdbfd32ae0d2aa_8897258895416148906.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"47_8002_突破的感受·承_jp.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"现在我有信心能够完美地完成鞭转了。不过训练量不能减。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/e18bfaafd0444c8b63679d269c37198a_4778672488057049467.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"48_8003_突破的感受·转_jp.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"「情感也是芭蕾舞不可欠缺的一部分。」现在我能理解它的含义了，谢谢你一直以来的陪伴和支持，今天有我的演出，这是门票。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/5d5ad72e4084efae15403d6a73446fca_3860492969549004689.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"49_8004_突破的感受·合_jp.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"开始了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki- "audio_name":"75_600002_加入队伍·其二_jp.mp3"},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"这次去哪里？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/53170a30fd65e44ef41a7a827bdbd633_1369488455995958262.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"76_600003_加入队伍·其三_jp.mp3"}],"tab_id":"1786518063637_3"},{"tab_name":"英语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"…谢谢你的支持，签名的后面需要什么图案？一片羽毛可以吗？噢，不是粉丝。看来是我误会了。重新自我介绍一下，奥黛塔，至冬科洛列夫茨基剧团的芭蕾舞者…依旧谢谢你的支持。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/fa067c8a1b2969ad135c79b7e0cb0e28_5674853878676723788.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"01_1006_初次见面…_en.mp3"},{"name":"闲聊·忙碌","content":"如果没有别的事情的话，我先去练习舞蹈了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/54db1d1d71a6c56724b6707b3ea810c2_3327764641526532598.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"02_1101_闲聊·忙碌_en.mp3"},{"name":"闲聊·简单","content":"能简单回应的事情，不需要长篇大论。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b56b3f86b41b2d84d125232486f3ecbf_3808871376256324154.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"03_1102_闲聊·简单_en.mp3"},{"name":"闲聊·时间","content":"时间能变成双倍…不，三倍就好了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6ef2be3fa972c4893e78e21639728aa8_3030160157884145922.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"04_1103_闲聊·时间_en.mp3"},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"雨滴落下时淅淅沥沥的声音总能让我感到平静，这样的天气很适合独自练舞。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/ae1046b31d6702ccf8fad6116017b07e_7304764517587844955.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"05_1201_下雨的时候…_en.mp3"},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"平静而美好的时刻总是短暂的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/77d0af4bb6b449e2a74bf8d5c0a9749d_7454250180899329117.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"06_1202_雨过天晴…_en.mp3"},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"至冬的雪，向来冷得刺骨，又永无尽头。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/e73a95cec8d75e0956b6fe8f3318eb7e_5013313861812036104.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"07_1204_下雪的时候…_en.mp3"},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"发型…等一下再重新梳理吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/816ad3553e90fadff183cbb69fddffb9_632644262674936490.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"08_1205_刮大风了…_en.mp3"},{"name":"在沙漠的时候…","content":"…还好不会在这种地方开见面会。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b6b6d3cf14632fffa938c3a26560cbc8_3716742197208676718.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"09_1206_在沙漠的时候…_en.mp3"},{"name":"早上好…","content":"我已经热身完毕，随时可以行动。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/7abbc592f26933bb21f3ff25b2feecbe_9134464950797926928.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"10_1001_早上好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"中午好…","content":"我不需要午睡，午后这种不适合训练的时间，我通常会看看舞剧剧本。嗯？你问这些信纸吗？是沃雅妮莎塞给我的粉丝来信，她要我好好看完。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/1e4ec3c8a7ededae88be99483c595660_6541720134908833066.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"11_1002_中午好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚饭时间到了吗？等下就要登台，吃一个煮鸡蛋就够了，等今晚演出全部结束之后，再随便吃点吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/05860155a95eb4310572343bc29d3049_5302816354291302070.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"12_1003_晚上好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"晚安…","content":"…任务完成，训练量达标，新舞蹈也练习完毕。表情管理有些不足，还需要再对着镜子调整一下…已经到这个时间了吗？你先休息吧，我还有安排。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/c8a987e58092ddfc5116d1421819ff10_7732449955762695766.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"13_1004_晚安…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社","content":"严冬计划推行后，来剧院看演出的观众越来越少了。大家的生活已经跌入困境，更有危害民众的蛀虫，对此我无法无动于衷。我知道仅凭一己之力无法扭转局势，但我仍想做一些力所能及的事情。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/d15a6831dc1285d06e464796029a6e72_9220599164807201657.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"14_2001_关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于奥黛塔自己·记性","content":"以前的记忆一直烙印在脑海中，在夜深人静的时候，像映影一样反复播放…记性太好不是好事。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/da5f647f7a4ed095b10a2a9252c4f513_4126998364782408480.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"15_2005_关于奥黛塔自己·记性_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·寄托","content":"来自他人的保护就像刚刚凝结而成的薄冰一样，是十分脆弱的东西，我不会把希望寄托在别人身上。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/21cacafdb90a2e6eff0364e76cffab29_6107690648847402317.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"16_2003_关于我们·寄托_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·伤口","content":"我对痛觉的感受很迟钝，等我察觉伤口时，伤口已经结痂了。这样也好。无论是练习舞蹈还是接受愚人众特训，都不会因为身体状况耽误我的日程。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/1045e12ddc87f37c08510060e061fc2a_3278434511695467972.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"17_2002_关于我们·伤口_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于「星之楔」…","content":"以前，在一次训练中，极寒冻伤了我的腿脚，让我近乎失去知觉，最后是在「星之楔」散发出的亮光中醒来的。不过从没有听说「星之楔」能将人唤醒的传闻，当时醒来是因为…我本能地想要活下去吗…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9c16fd68dfb69ed7a81e5f997fb262a4_6725884085159094566.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"18_3006_关于「星之楔」…_en.mp3"},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"每一次彩排，我都会当作正式演出一样认真对待。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/c9a50f84abd40b774e33548962416235_747756483832855282.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"19_3002_有什么想要分享…_en.mp3"},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"有些冰醋栗吃起来不够甜，只要撒一些细盐，就会变得香甜好吃了。据说是有了咸味的衬托，甜味就会被放大。一位粉丝告诉我的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/1ac069979f77dde07bdfe85fe7810973_8132292058320366013.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"20_3003_感兴趣的见闻…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于罗莎琳·曾经","content":"罗莎琳有恩于我，但我也一度憎恨着她。她的要求非常严苛，在她手下训练的那段时间，挨冻、累倒、受伤与生病都是常有的事情。曾经我天真地想，只要我能独立站上舞台，靠跳芭蕾舞也能养活自己和母亲了，我就离开愚人众给她看。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6a2461f587d6719cc7458277ab765841_2555282063021244444.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"21_4001_关于罗莎琳·曾经_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于罗莎琳·燃珀","content":"人不在了，很多话就失去了说出口的意义。「燃珀」砸碎起来是那么容易，却让误会和伤痛显得更加讽刺…为什么事到如今，我们才能互相理解呢？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/f58187d30328a2763402fd1a9c164907_1767399068862290335.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22_4002_关于罗莎琳·燃珀_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于「女皇」陛下…","content":"「女皇」陛下是全至冬的信仰，她事务繁忙，鲜少露面。我能见到她的次数寥寥无几，她十分庄重威严，她的目光不管落在哪里，都像是万年不化的冰雪一般冰冷但坚定。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b15f8d175427d791967da877a3bfb191_8508370954118062367.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"23_4003_关于「女皇」陛下…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于「少女」大人…","content":"她走路的姿态好像一片羽毛在飘起飘落。任何一位舞者都会羡慕这份轻盈。沃雅妮莎也曾和我聊起过她空灵的歌声。但我们看到与羡慕的，都是她「台前」的模样，我们并不了解真实的她心中是否背负着不为人知的痛苦，不是吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b8985f00d19fcd5c2cd2485dfa27a59b_3631085972424599250.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"24_4004_关于「少女」大人…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于「仆人」大人…","content":"壁炉之家的孩子们都将「仆人」大人视为「父亲」。有父亲庇佑的孩子，成长路上总归会少些冰雪风雨。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9f89e96dc09eb7c8c49997b1e8ef9d75_5924294292380678206.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"25_4005_关于「仆人」大人…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于「木偶」大人…","content":"从前罗莎琳参加完「木偶」大人的茶会，心情都会变得比平时更好——虽然要求依旧严苛，但语气明显缓和了许多，任何人都能察觉出来。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/5f771eea1c16fbdff98583db2612ccea_2899063100891248777.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"26_4006_关于「木偶」大人…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于沃雅妮莎·微笑","content":"第一次「女皇」陛下要来科洛列夫茨基剧团看我们演出的时候，沃雅妮莎提前把这个消息告诉了我，我回答说嗯。结果她伸出食指把我的嘴角提了上去，硬是制造出一个微笑，还要我跟着她一起念：「太、好、了！」我依然不觉得「女皇」陛下喜欢看到那样的笑容。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6e78426ffae8084b4e4a6c1d70fcaedc_6781478869138291675.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"27_4007_关于沃雅妮莎·微笑_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于沃雅妮莎·看病","content":"沃雅妮莎生病的时候总会缠着我，让我陪着她一起…理由是万一需要打针或者吃苦药的话，她会很害怕的，所以想要紧紧抓住我的胳膊。我的痛觉很不明显，自然也不会甩开她。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b119034e8d78e541782501e4f85bfe6f_4033064880151361103.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"28_4008_关于沃雅妮莎·看病_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于阿罗夏…","content":"身为猎户养活自己并不难，但他还是经常来剧院打零工，为了援助那些受苦的人们…我并不奇怪他会加入呼啸社。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/2e254848364cf7426d992c3af7a7c3b7_6491192603936266569.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29_4009_关于阿罗夏…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于米提亚…","content":"这位…「粉丝」先生，他经常来剧院观看我和沃雅妮莎的表演。但每次表演开始，他都在低着头写些什么，在一众翘首看向舞台的观众中很是醒目。或许他的围巾比他更懂得欣赏演出。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/1b9ee163ce6c3691e58dbbbc2a5898b0_5944556441283344800.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"30_4010_关于米提亚…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于瓦列里…","content":"瓦列里少校，一位有着严格时间观念的愚人众军官，听说他总用一种冷静且骇人的态度为同僚安排工作。但我们所属不同所以鲜有交集，而且…我该做的事情并不需要任何人提醒。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/d7f6ca8fdc37161bee6b4ce63ae45a5a_5311341325328337721.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"31_4011_关于瓦列里…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于薇斯纳…","content":"别因为她有对翅膀，就把她当成华丽无害的蝴蝶，那个受人簇拥的家伙是冬契军的总司令，冰雪之中的猎食者。你要擦亮眼睛，别被热情的笑容骗了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/06781194aa57f0774b39221d14d83c48_3119604984708184307.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"32_4012_关于薇斯纳…_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其一","content":"我的日程安排比较紧凑，等会儿还有训练。请见谅。要聊天的话，我们长话短说。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/30d4dd24ed838528efa02cbba295a597_5362091892687579673.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"33_5001_想要了解奥黛塔·其一_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其二","content":"我的母亲出自芭蕾世家，父亲曾效力愚人众，他们因一次演出而结缘，那是一段能让任何听者都露出笑容的浪漫往事。幼时，母亲会带我一起轻盈地跳舞，父亲会给我买漂亮的新舞裙。我唯一的烦恼是每天到底要从糖果罐子里选择哪一块。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/0347105a3900422ccf89fa5c459deeb2_2857460935558514445.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34_5002_想要了解奥黛塔·其二_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其三","content":"后来父亲因公殉职的噩耗传来，母亲悲痛欲绝，在演出时摔断了腿。糖果罐子里所有的糖都洒了出去，而我被关在了那里面。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/3ea7d17a7e29cbba13a750b14f99e61c_956037615107054915.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"35_5003_想要了解奥黛塔·其三_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其四","content":"再后来的事情，你也知道了。这些回忆被我咀嚼了太多次，已经不会再伤害到我了。但对抗命运过程中获得的力量，却是属于我自己的。我不会忘记这一点。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/1f6b7d1a272345f04629d82098b2666f_6827796849253255044.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"36_5004_想要了解奥黛塔·其四_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其五","content":"我不想对任何粉丝说这些，好在你不是。我的身份已经太多了，任何一面最好都保持其应有的剔透…我会向着我心中的完美舞下去。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/308707b8bf507ad3dd16088720876c3e_4407169657467480732.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"37_5005_想要了解奥黛塔·其五_en.mp3"},{"name":"奥黛塔的爱好…","content":"从始至终我都很喜欢芭蕾，我会竭尽全力在这个舞台上为观众带来我能跳出的最好的舞蹈。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/815bfdebdd2167e6bf3d82f93dfb70f1_8628093722698217162.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"38_6001_奥黛塔的爱好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"奥黛塔的烦恼…","content":"说实话我一直觉得自己不太受小动物欢迎。剧院周围经常有小猫出没，沃雅妮莎会拉着我一起去喂它，我一走过去，小猫就开始磨爪子…嗯？你说那是欢迎我的意思吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/2d6e32fae382c7ce503447960e99169f_6975082162836630050.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"39_6012_奥黛塔的烦恼…_en.mp3"},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"餐厅快打烊时，会半价出售当天的沙拉，从前有段时间经常吃这个。放久了的沙拉味道当然比不上新鲜的，但因为口感实在熟悉，反倒让人安心。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9e7a365e6add998792ccb15336b0b792_1650974718548698687.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"40_6003_喜欢的食物…_en.mp3"},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"从我个人喜好上来说，并没有难以下咽的食物。但作为芭蕾舞者，必须在饮食上保持克制，每日饮食计划外的食物是不推荐吃的。所以我不吃。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a75a369814733e3f530dd47885b49942_5916935847940410250.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"41_6004_讨厌的食物…_en.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"这几天演出比较多，或许…不，没什么。谢谢你，这个很美味。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/16fe11e66ebbf377d92e3edb8a013f9c_3610329756630620441.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"42_6007_收到赠礼·其一_en.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"一道菜？更像…一整天的食物。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/798a81f53ca47693e197d682cd88a2a5_1517861292499191473.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"43_6008_收到赠礼·其二_en.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"抱歉，我在控制体重。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/7e99602e4fb1eaffdd1589036513104f_7129926475047671920.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"44_6009_收到赠礼·其三_en.mp3"},{"name":"生日…","content":"生日快乐。不知道你想要怎样的生日礼物？我收到的总是鲜花、舞鞋与音乐盒。但我猜那并不是你的愿望。不如你向我许愿吧，只要是我能实现的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/f3d9f17bb53bb9c39829138fba622186_6690604433080564811.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"45_7001_生日…_en.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"还欠缺了一些什么…再加点训练量好了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/c6301bfc52fa07eb6e5360b7fcdf319a_4772211048522336487.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"46_8001_突破的感受·起_en.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"嗯，动作更加精准了。保持这样的训练量。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/ab7c9ff8ead15e478ca478d3b39ba423_4702265369269524369.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"47_8002_突破的感受·承_en.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"现在我有信心能够完美地完成鞭转了。不过训练量不能减。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/0af90ee9eccd1171a2853c7f87dd35c6_2204943600587186874.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"48_8003_突破的感受·转_en.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"「情感也是芭蕾舞不可欠缺的一部分。」现在我能理解它的含义了，谢谢你一直以来的陪伴和支持，今天有我的演出，这是门票。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b249b76e3849a579e2bc37de77b46e77_6764257764365817755.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"49_8004_突破的感受·合_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"开始了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/10/13/16576950/411c827812522a9f27016909debc9ea8_5795781133970731910.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"50_100001_元素战技·其一_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"冰中雪影。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/01c396e5345d0cefcadc2590c58b4dfa_5826214389209212528.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"51_100002_元素战技·其二_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"起。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b029fe8a5a81e9f133de78254b1c8efe_6698803418997788569.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"52_100003_元素战技·其三_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"共舞时刻。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/8d077b3c4785c33eac1e8bc25840ae03_8388435476462294116.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"53_100004_元素战技·其四_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"旋转。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6ae499fe9d36163556e7724e8bd1cda8_1768955887612306405.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"54_100005_元素战技·其五_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其六","content":"呵。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6f713da2f5a52101f67b73e0577b86d6_5368983390758950439.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"55_100006_元素战技·其六_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"冰封的旋律。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/ad13cb3b935ccca86c82c34948915740_1501819985495247527.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"56_200001_元素爆发·其一_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"镂冰履凌。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/3cf522feea05da37f301e2b124ddfe46_4615036018448467608.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"57_200002_元素爆发·其二_en.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"献上，雪鹄的礼赞。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.c …","content":"至冬的雪，向来冷得刺骨，又永无尽头。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/0b2ee69350e6c1a53a51605c874f814e_8319256083406061533.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"07_1204_下雪的时候…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"发型…等一下再重新梳理吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/08f73ad1f3a029876ed2b6eaafe6b5c7_1767259335340332120.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"08_1205_刮大风了…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"在沙漠的时候…","content":"…还好不会在这种地方开见面会。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/e9a97b1be5858202204a0c03cdf37d58_2085605448951130838.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"09_1206_在沙漠的时候…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"早上好…","content":"我已经热身完毕，随时可以行动。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/35ee47a99f1a36fa0024a25fccdce2aa_5217741676931649708.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"10_1001_早上好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"中午好…","content":"我不需要午睡，午后这种不适合训练的时间，我通常会看看舞剧剧本。嗯？你问这些信纸吗？是沃雅妮莎塞给我的粉丝来信，她要我好好看完。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6eac897d5e03f9b04a841b6e8e372940_3104014420856542795.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"11_1002_中午好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚饭时间到了吗？等下就要登台，吃一个煮鸡蛋就够了，等今晚演出全部结束之后，再随便吃点吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/aeea3a1dc94b82cd5b96a0b830862631_3650283516265588857.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"12_1003_晚上好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"晚安…","content":"…任务完成，训练量达标，新舞蹈也练习完毕。表情管理有些不足，还需要再对着镜子调整一下…已经到这个时间了吗？你先休息吧，我还有安排。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/868eef8343f6815fdaebcc7fd74f5b8f_3312240062387843524.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"13_1004_晚安…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社","content":"严冬计划推行后，来剧院看演出的观众越来越少了。大家的生活已经跌入困境，更有危害民众的蛀虫，对此我无法无动于衷。我知道仅凭一己之力无法扭转局势，但我仍想做一些力所能及的事情。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/b2a9e270dac6c0670844eca039445847_1500733001544012176.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"14_2001_关于奥黛塔自己·呼啸社_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于奥黛塔自己·记性","content":"以前的记忆一直烙印在脑海中，在夜深人静的时候，像映影一样反复播放…记性太好不是好事。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/bbaecd5d95438c97e4a2cd34cfa100ca_8641821592962065429.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"15_2005_关于奥黛塔自己·记性_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·寄托","content":"来自他人的保护就像刚刚凝结而成的薄冰一样，是十分脆弱的东西，我不会把希望寄托在别人身上。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/76f187ba804fbac0eb8bab2b1895b1a7_1807769382221289067.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"16_2003_关于我们·寄托_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·伤口","content":"我对痛觉的感受很迟钝，等我察觉伤口时，伤口已经结痂了。这样也好。无论是练习舞蹈还是接受愚人众特训，都不会因为身体状况耽误我的日程。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/32999423f9743aac7b9f7a5abd733c59_6427528343636932444.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"17_2002_关于我们·伤口_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于「星之楔」…","content":"以前，在一次训练中，极寒冻伤了我的腿脚，让我近乎失去知觉，最后是在「星之楔」散发出的亮光中醒来的。不过从没有听说「星之楔」能将人唤醒的传闻，当时醒来是因为…我本能地想要活下去吗…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/1e747ef1159b3dd9141a1c318568d420_3991099880253252913.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"18_3006_关于「星之楔」…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"每一次彩排，我都会当作正式演出一样认真对待。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/d508681f3a3c28e9af04d8c7e9010729_4729402743322367411.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"19_3002_有什么想要分享…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"有些冰醋栗吃起来不够甜，只要撒一些细盐，就会变得香甜好吃了。据说是有了咸味的衬托，甜味就会被放大。一位粉丝告诉我的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/5e233b9410685b9feb5ff0facb4b1022_8974809922007142588.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"20_3003_感兴趣的见闻…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于罗莎琳·曾经","content":"罗莎琳有恩于我，但我也一度憎恨着她。她的要求非常严苛，在她手下训练的那段时间，挨冻、累倒、受伤与生病都是常有的事情。曾经我天真地想，只要我能独立站上舞台，靠跳芭蕾舞也能养活自己和母亲了，我就离开愚人众给她看。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a612a4825922667d89e46b2804a333a4_4743385895173456658.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"21_4001_关于罗莎琳·曾经_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于罗莎琳·燃珀","content":"人不在了，很多话就失去了说出口的意义。「燃珀」砸碎起来是那么容易，却让误会和伤痛显得更加讽刺…为什么事到如今，我们才能互相理解呢？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/a612a4825922667d89e46b2804a333a4_2087237239862257184.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22_4002_关于罗莎琳·燃珀_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于「女皇」陛下…","content":"「女皇」陛下是全至冬的信仰，她事务繁忙，鲜少露面。我能见到她的次数寥寥无几，她十分庄重威严，她的目光不管落在哪里，都像是万年不化的冰雪一般冰冷但坚定。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/4e239c05ad35a34ca615712a956b0ad9_803159079320244052.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"23_4003_关于「女皇」陛下…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于「少女」大人…","content":"她走路的姿态好像一片羽毛在飘起飘落。任何一位舞者都会羡慕这份轻盈。沃雅妮莎也曾和我聊起过她空灵的歌声。但我们看到与羡慕的，都是她「台前」的模样，我们并不了解真实的她心中是否背负着不为人知的痛苦，不是吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/35e5d1b69ee7f8bd35bbf514fe0bdeb0_7335397183085927446.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"24_4004_关于「少女」大人…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于「仆人」大人…","content":"壁炉之家的孩子们都将「仆人」大人视为「父亲」。有父亲庇佑的孩子，成长路上总归会少些冰雪风雨。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6b71ca256eb031a27acd4fd96c06a577_1943658378671478980.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"25_4005_关于「仆人」大人…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于「木偶」大人…","content":"从前罗莎琳参加完「木偶」大人的茶会，心情都会变得比平时更好——虽然要求依旧严苛，但语气明显缓和了许多，任何人都能察觉出来。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/571b65605b5676a09130fd68195d5d2c_3620366291534663432.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"26_4006_关于「木偶」大人…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于沃雅妮莎·微笑","content":"第一次「女皇」陛下要来科洛列夫茨基剧团看我们演出的时候，沃雅妮莎提前把这个消息告诉了我，我回答说嗯。结果她伸出食指把我的嘴角提了上去，硬是制造出一个微笑，还要我跟着她一起念：「太、好、了！」我依然不觉得「女皇」陛下喜欢看到那样的笑容。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/389a8ce28d17dc523cf30bb57ab82372_5386038683487390254.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"27_4007_关于沃雅妮莎·微笑_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于沃雅妮莎·看病","content":"沃雅妮莎生病的时候总会缠着我，让我陪着她一起…理由是万一需要打针或者吃苦药的话，她会很害怕的，所以想要紧紧抓住我的胳膊。我的痛觉很不明显，自然也不会甩开她。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/006fbf63d268d812fe18ebbae9ac4b07_5137830363385696158.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"28_4008_关于沃雅妮莎·看病_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于阿罗夏…","content":"身为猎户养活自己并不难，但他还是经常来剧院打零工，为了援助那些受苦的人们…我并不奇怪他会加入呼啸社。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/0fdebf57dcd44c24fd8833017c88d29d_1206126331237131699.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29_4009_关于阿罗夏…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于米提亚…","content":"这位…「粉丝」先生，他经常来剧院观看我和沃雅妮莎的表演。但每次表演开始，他都在低着头写些什么，在一众翘首看向舞台的观众中很是醒目。或许他的围巾比他更懂得欣赏演出。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/af1c473ecb268a594b6598cdb1b89b09_5809086686629670143.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"30_4010_关于米提亚…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于瓦列里…","content":"瓦列里少校，一位有着严格时间观念的愚人众军官，听说他总用一种冷静且骇人的态度为同僚安排工作。但我们所属不同所以鲜有交集，而且…我该做的事情并不需要任何人提醒。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/32a8c95376a26fb05be759f1f6ca5ea8_6762747839956074400.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"31_4011_关于瓦列里…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于薇斯纳…","content":"别因为她有对翅膀，就把她当成华丽无害的蝴蝶，那个受人簇拥的家伙是冬契军的总司令，冰雪之中的猎食者。你要擦亮眼睛，别被热情的笑容骗了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/4ffe1c70203bd75cedbac0d2a1afd86d_2433945987327025581.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"32_4012_关于薇斯纳…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其一","content":"我的日程安排比较紧凑，等会儿还有训练。请见谅。要聊天的话，我们长话短说。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/5a4db06d54aebdde9ae9532e3648ce8c_636748394946086623.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"33_5001_想要了解奥黛塔·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其二","content":"我的母亲出自芭蕾世家，父亲曾效力愚人众，他们因一次演出而结缘，那是一段能让任何听者都露出笑容的浪漫往事。幼时，母亲会带我一起轻盈地跳舞，父亲会给我买漂亮的新舞裙。我唯一的烦恼是每天到底要从糖果罐子里选择哪一块。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9aac820ca52c11862afcb00ccb0efee8_6205797623152477005.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34_5002_想要了解奥黛塔·其二_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其三","content":"后来父亲因公殉职的噩耗传来，母亲悲痛欲绝，在演出时摔断了腿。糖果罐子里所有的糖都洒了出去，而我被关在了那里面。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/ee62eb337ddbfb6a3322cd05c84da465_6784171222040563676.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"35_5003_想要了解奥黛塔·其三_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其四","content":"再后来的事情，你也知道了。这些回忆被我咀嚼了太多次，已经不会再伤害到我了。但对抗命运过程中获得的力量，却是属于我自己的。我不会忘记这一点。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/d47d2f3cfa019958b9824d08c24ea972_4241621163707382361.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"36_5004_想要了解奥黛塔·其四_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解奥黛塔·其五","content":"我不想对任何粉丝说这些，好在你不是。我的身份已经太多了，任何一面最好都保持其应有的剔透…我会向着我心中的完美舞下去。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/eb1157c1abf03ca1f937e3dc6dad393b_9154193935982664657.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"37_5005_想要了解奥黛塔·其五_kr.mp3"},{"name":"奥黛塔的爱好…","content":"从始至终我都很喜欢芭蕾，我会竭尽全力在这个舞台上为观众带来我能跳出的最好的舞蹈。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/eb1157c1abf03ca1f937e3dc6dad393b_7299727639756171956.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"38_6001_奥黛塔的爱好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"奥黛塔的烦恼…","content":"说实话我一直觉得自己不太受小动物欢迎。剧院周围经常有小猫出没，沃雅妮莎会拉着我一起去喂它，我一走过去，小猫就开始磨爪子…嗯？你说那是欢迎我的意思吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6da410eb3618051d40d67a8c8500d552_5725775898947278484.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"39_6012_奥黛塔的烦恼…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"餐厅快打烊时，会半价出售当天的沙拉，从前有段时间经常吃这个。放久了的沙拉味道当然比不上新鲜的，但因为口感实在熟悉，反倒让人安心。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6b013dc63dc794977cfbb68083258f94_3560208772472808637.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"40_6003_喜欢的食物…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"从我个人喜好上来说，并没有难以下咽的食物。但作为芭蕾舞者，必须在饮食上保持克制，每日饮食计划外的食物是不推荐吃的。所以我不吃。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/21710dd475fa104f7fada528c1fb0153_3231735658072711352.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"41_6004_讨厌的食物…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"这几天演出比较多，或许…不，没什么。谢谢你，这个很美味。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/504a4f2dfc6fc5a2a970cb296718bb14_1807955660684672760.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"42_6007_收到赠礼·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"一道菜？更像…一整天的食物。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/f9305fdcb38dd0ac2f429c4608818aa4_1790287413356544401.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"43_6008_收到赠礼·其二_kr.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"抱歉，我在控制体重。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/38ca7ec765979b9cda4122db3ea5bf60_4343766658324703340.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"44_6009_收到赠礼·其三_kr.mp3"},{"name":"生日…","content":"生日快乐。不知道你想要怎样的生日礼物？我收到的总是鲜花、舞鞋与音乐盒。但我猜那并不是你的愿望。不如你向我许愿吧，只要是我能实现的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/9db458e008b3e008730d457d505de306_180947420454511345.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"45_7001_生日…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"还欠缺了一些什么…再加点训练量好了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/2cc9c3b7b07e1178466bf436711e6ec9_6739612762903077010.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"46_8001_突破的感受·起_kr.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"嗯，动作更加精准了。保持这样的训练量。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/6a578854ccec3f436957e1a55d430b6f_5788745517756785298.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"47_8002_突破的感受·承_kr.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"现在我有信心能够完美地完成鞭转了。不过训练量不能减。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/12/16576950/08943bf58a79fccc8d0611dc5157c521_4377084675625580686.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"48_8003_突破的感受·转_kr.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"「情感也是芭蕾舞不可欠缺的一部分。」现在我能理解它的含义了，谢谢你一直以来的陪伴和支持，今天有我的演出，这是门票。","audio_url":"https://ac 至冬科洛列夫茨基剧团的每季演出落幕之后，各大报刊的文艺版面总会掀起一场关于首席芭蕾舞者奥黛塔的狂热讨论。

「完美无缺，冷若冰霜。」——某文艺报频繁使用的这句评语，几乎成了她的固定注脚。

知名评论家特里波列夫曾在专栏中写道：「看奥黛塔跳舞，如同目睹一柄打磨到极致的匕首划破空气。人人都叹服于那份锋利与精准，却绝不会想伸手触碰。」

这样的评价若放在其他舞者身上，或多或少会影响他们的艺术前程。观众总是喜欢美的东西。而美的东西又最好是柔软的，是抒情的，是动人的。它越是易于触碰，便越是易于被感知。

但奥黛塔全然不同。观众渴望看到的热情、感动，哪怕是谢幕时那发自内心的笑容，她一概不做提供。

除了舞蹈中配合剧情的必要表情，即便在公开见面会或私下场合，她也依旧神情寡淡。

就像是她把所有的力气都用在了雕琢她的舞蹈技艺上，她以远超首席芭蕾舞者的标准要求自己，而其结果有目共睹。但伪装自己的情绪，取悦观众是首席舞者该做的事吗？她显然不这么认为。

坊间流传着许多关于她的小故事：

某位贵族豪掷千金包下整排头等席，散场后捧着大束的冰蓝色花朵在后台门口等了两个小时，最后只等到工作人员转达的一句：「首席已从侧门离开。」

一封长达十页的倾慕来信，收到的回信却只有一如既往的谢谢支持，若非那笔迹与奥黛塔的签名一致，简直要让人怀疑是他人代笔。

更有一位狂热粉丝喝醉后堵在剧院门口，语无伦次地想要和奥黛塔探讨芭蕾对至冬的影响，奥黛塔出门时并未绕行，只是停下脚步，静静看了他一眼…据目击者回忆：「那人愣了几秒，然后像被浇了一盆冰水一样，自己嘀咕着什么转身走了。」

……

她不包装感受，不美化生活，但她像她脚下的冻土那般坚决，寒冷，顽强。她的力量是一种剔透而真实的力量，是至冬人骨子里亲切的共鸣。

奥黛塔依然冷淡，剧院门口排队购票的人依然络绎不绝，一如雪下个不停。

就算是在科洛列夫茨基剧团内，能和奥黛塔在演出之外随意聊天的人也屈指可数。

但毋庸置疑，沃雅妮莎算一位。

她们最初的交集仅限于舞台调度上的几句工作沟通，节目如何安排？服装准备情况如何？当然，还有安抚因为新上台而太过紧张的演员。

「按照平时的练习来，聆听节奏，记住步伐，一步接一步。」首席芭蕾舞者冷静、几乎面无表情地如此告诫着，其内容和平时练习时的训导并无二致，就好像登台演出跟平时的练习也没有什么不同。演员们你看看我，我看看你，激烈的心跳在没有说出口的疑问中平息。首席芭蕾舞者的声音是如此平静，就像一场新雪落下，渐渐抚平了雪原上的那些踉跄又慌张的脚印。

「好了，姑娘们，拍拍胸膛，让心跳得再快点，你们要在台上玩个痛快了！」首席女高音高昂、甚至有些高亢地宣告道，她的女孩们拍着胸脯，脸蛋激动地通红，首席女高音的声音就像是在海面汹涌澎湃的波涛，只要足够勇敢且聪明，就能搭着这股奔流呼啸向前。

演员们依次上台，两位首席在后台稍坐，她们的演出已然圆满收场，接下来是只属于新人的最后一幕。

为这场演出，她们已竭尽所能做到最好。直到舞台上的乐声响起，才隐约地打破了休息室内的沉默。

一颗蜂蜜糖落在了水妖的水杯里，如同珍珠滑入丝绸，传来一声轻微的「咚」。

「…对嗓子好。」

没有其他多余的话，奥黛塔径直离开，她认真地绑起了自己的舞鞋，留下沃雅妮莎对着面前香甜的热水发呆。

沃雅妮莎后来才知道，平日里那是奥黛塔留给她自己的——长时间高强度训练后用来补充体力的糖。当时她手上也只剩最后一颗。奥黛塔同样是后来才知道，身为水妖的沃雅妮莎在唱歌这方面格外天赋异禀，嗓子基本不会感觉到疲惫。

——而对那时的沃雅妮莎来说，她倒是很乐于接受一份来自他人的真诚的善意。更何况，这个「他人」剔透纯净得像一块好看的冰。

加入愚人众后，奥黛塔脸上的稚气很快褪去。

白天是芭蕾的基本功练习，夜晚是雷打不动的愚人众训练，她从一边跳向另一边，在两套日程的夹缝中喘息。

身体的抗议起初还有迹可循：脚踝传来难忍的刺痛，接着膝盖在每次起跳时发出细响，而后是肋下那片任务中撞出的淤青迟迟不褪。疼痛排着长队，一个接一个报到。

她没有理会，只是把绷带缠紧一圈，护具加厚一层，将疼痛强行压回身体深处，用更剧烈的训练去掩埋。

那段时间，母亲觉察到她的训练量陡增，像在急切证明什么。而面对母亲的规劝，奥黛塔的回应永远是「没事」。

在一次次近乎自我伤害的咬牙坚持中，她对痛的感知越来越迟钝，直到最后——痛感消失了。

那晚战斗训练结束得很迟。回到住处后，疲惫的奥黛塔脱下挡风的斗篷，低头时，她看见缠在腿上的绷带洇出一片深色。血比平时多得多，旧伤又裂开了。

她盯着看了几秒钟。

什么感觉都没有，像在看别人的伤口。

她试探着用力按下去——直到她的力道足以将肌肉按出凹陷…可她的腿纹丝未动。

毫无痛感。

奥黛塔沉默了片刻，重新缠好绷带，在黑暗中静坐了许久。

从今以后，她不再需要麻木自己的感官，封闭自己的感受了，无论哪边的训练都可以坚持得更久。

她甚至感到一丝庆幸。这样下去，应该很快就能实现那个成为科洛列夫茨基剧团首席芭蕾舞者的愿望。

她不知疲惫地跳啊跳，直至紧绷的足尖在旋转与飞跃中掠过每一幕舞剧，每一种以爱塑造的幻想。

她是完美的淑女，她是高贵的公主。她是冬日晨霜般优雅的水鸟，她是夏日烈阳般热忱的舞姬。她是孔雀般的美人米莱狄，她是大盗雷德·米勒的女伴安莉，她是歌裴莉娅，也是欧黛莉娅。

可所有这些都不是「奥黛塔」。

——那么，我要度过怎样的一生呢？

幕布落下，无人知晓的声音在心中升起。

——他们说，新世界总会到来。如果新世界的人们要把我的一生写成舞台上的故事，我希望那是什么样的形象？

她不知道。舞剧的开场应当是浪漫的，至少是优美的。和睦的家庭，欢笑的童年，所有这些都已经太过遥远，比舞台上刺眼的灯光还要遥远。仿佛要将双目灼伤那般，她死死望向那苍白如火的光，却发觉自己早已不再渴望那份温暖，也不需要虚假的柔情。

属于她的只有苦痛。冰冷的、刺骨的、如呼啸的风雪般神圣肃穆的苦痛。

那是塑造了「奥黛塔」，磨炼她而又陪伴她最久的挚友。

——是啊，我希望死去的旧世界记住我的顽强。

——苦痛是我的羽翼，我的翅膀。我要飞往最高的地方去看一看，我要见到雪鹄未曾见证的梦，那才是我的愿望。

这样想着，她眯起双眼，望向高悬于舞台上空的灯。

恍惚、飘曳、遥不可及，却又是那般触手可及的灯。

与往常一样，又是一次竭尽全力的、仿佛要让身体燃烧殆尽的献舞。

幕布落下，回到后台，一枚冰蓝色的结晶在冷冽的微光中凝结成形。

奥黛塔默不作声地将它拾起，放在掌心端详。星之楔，作为愚人众，她粗略地听说过这东西的来历。但它摸上去与想象不同——冰冷，轻若无物，像一滴凝固在风雪中的泪。

她不相信泪水，正如她不相信很多事。与她失去的痛觉一样，不知是怜悯、恩赐还是诅咒。

从今往后，没有疼痛会让她在出剑前迟疑，没有寒冷会令她在雪夜中迟缓。

奥黛塔抬起头来，望向窗外的天空。雪花飘落在她自认早已变得冰凉的面颊，随后被温热地融化。
